about_the_game:
Welcome to the Official Demo for Cyber Horror: Project S.Y.L.A.!

This demo contains the opening chapter of the game, designed to introduce you to the nightmarish world of Cybranth, the start of the story, and the core gameplay mechanics. The full game will feature the complete narrative, additional areas, and many more dangers.

The Story Begins

The year is 2091. S.Y.L.A., the central A.I. designed to manage the city of Cybranth, has spiraled out of control, plunging the neon-soaked streets into chaos. Amid the evacuation, your sister vanished without a trace. Now, you must infiltrate the forbidden, quarantined city to find her and face the horror that lurks inside.

What to Expect in This Demo

  • Test Your Stealth: Push your survival skills to the limit by avoiding patrol drones and AI-driven abominations corrupted by S.Y.L.A.’s code.

  • Explore the City's Entrance: Traverse the abandoned neon-lit streets, eerie skyscrapers, and high-tech facilities at the edge of the quarantine zone.

  • Find the First Clues: Discover the initial notes, audio logs, and hidden files that begin the search for your sister’s fate and the origins of the S.Y.L.A. project.

Your Journey Starts Here

This demo is just the beginning of the nightmare. Can you survive the initial encounters? Will the clues you find only lead to darker questions?

⭐ Please Wishlist the Full Game! If you enjoy this taste of Cybranth, please add the full game to your wishlist to be notified on launch. Your support is crucial for us!

⭐ Share Your Feedback! This demo is also our chance to hear from you. Please share your thoughts, suggestions, and any bugs you encounter in the Discussions section of our Community Hub.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ R5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
